source_snapshot_2015.operator_inference_rule: Owner and LifecycleStatus establish historical ownership/status only. They do not identify the operator unless an independent source explicitly does so.

current_operator_classes.evidence: PRASA FY2024 Consulting Engineer's Report states PRASA owns and operates 835 WWPSs at the June 2024 GIS snapshot.

current_operator_classes.entity: Local Redevelopment Authority for Roosevelt Roads
current_operator_classes.system_scope: existing sanitary sewer system at former Naval Station Roosevelt Roads
current_operator_classes.source_claim: LRA owns, operates, repairs, and maintains the existing sanitary sewer system; sanitary utility issues are addressed through LRA, not PRASA.

current_operator_classes.system_scope: Palmas del Mar private water/sewer utility
current_operator_classes.source_claim: PDMU currently operates the sanitary sewer system and reports five pumping stations in the wastewater system.

current_operator_classes.system_scope: Coco Beach / Grand Reserve wastewater utility
current_operator_classes.source_claim: EPA final NPDES permit is effective 2025-12-01 through 2030-11-30; EPA fact sheet identifies Coco Beach Utility Company as the wastewater operator.

current_operator_classes.entity: Villas del Gigante / Public Works Department of Carolina Municipality
current_operator_classes.source_claim: EPA permit materials identify the Public Works Department of Carolina Municipality as permittee and the Municipal Aqueduct Department of Carolina as facility contact; current EPA/ECHO evidence retains PR0026042 as administratively continued.

Act 60-2024 identifies Caguas Real Utility Corp. as one of the three private aqueduct/sewer systems and notes the then-current franchise expiration in 2025; no authoritative 2026 sewer-franchise renewal was recovered in the bounded search.
Army report states Fort Buchanan wastewater is serviced by PRASA and PRASA is responsible for inspection and maintenance of sewer lines.

private_franchise_universe.scope: Private aqueduct and sewer systems operating under Puerto Rico public-service franchises as described by Act 60-2024 legislative findings.

municipal_operator_test.entity: Villas del Gigante Development WWTP / Carolina Municipality
municipal_operator_test.source_claim: EPA permit materials identify the Public Works Department of Carolina Municipality as permittee, with the Municipal Aqueduct Department of Carolina as facility contact. This supersedes the earlier bounded no-municipal-POTW finding.
municipal_operator_test.caveat: Municipal POTW/permittee evidence does not imply any pump-station count or permittee-to-EBAS-operator identity.

final_partition_policy.AAA_OWNED: Use only where authoritative source explicitly attributes ownership to AAA/PRASA.
final_partition_policy.AAA_OPERATED: Use only where authoritative source explicitly attributes operation/service/maintenance to AAA/PRASA.
final_partition_policy.NON_AAA_OWNED: Use where source explicitly attributes ownership/control to private, governmental, municipal, or other non-AAA entity.
final_partition_policy.NON_AAA_OPERATED: Use only where source explicitly attributes operation/maintenance/service responsibility to a non-AAA entity.
final_partition_policy.NPDES_PERMITTEE: Preserve as a distinct regulatory role and do not automatically equate with owner, system operator, or EBAS operator.
final_partition_policy.UNKNOWN: Use whenever owner/operator cannot be independently resolved or where historical ownership is being improperly used as an operator proxy.

non_aaa_current_system_operators_confirm: Local Redevelopment Authority for Roosevelt Roads
terminal_state.reason: Current non-AAA sanitary-system operation/permittee roles are proven across private, public-corporation, and municipal classes, but no complete current operator census or row-level pump-station universe exists across all classes.
